base.description: Pinned baseline: SGLang at the study branch point; NVFP4 MoE on FlashInfer CUTLASS (the tree's auto choice, flashinfer_trtllm, is SM100-only and crashes on SM120); decode CUDA graphs up to bs 32 (the largest gate workload); attention, FP8 KV cache (from the checkpoint) and dense GEMMs on the tree's defaults.

chunk8k.description: T1 (W3): one-chunk W8 prefill. --chunked-prefill-size 8192 so 8x1024 is one chunk; --mem-fraction-static pinned to base's resolved 0.718 so the KV pool does not change with the chunk size.

splits16.description: T2 (W3): Triton decode attention split-KV count 16 (tree default 8).

w32a-mem080.description: T-W32a (gemma4nv-b3-w32a): base plus --mem-fraction-static 0.80, so the KV pools (66k full / 53k sliding tokens) hold W32's 32 x 1152 tokens without retraction; see trials/W32-DIAG.md.

w32b-mem076.description: T-W32b (gemma4nv-b3-w32b, variant of T-W32a): base plus --mem-fraction-static 0.76, the smallest probed fraction whose KV pools (52k full / 41.5k sliding tokens) hold W32 without retraction while leaving 5.2 GB for the teacher-forced logprob peak that OOMed 0.80; see trials/W32-DIAG.md.

smallm-gemm.description: T3 (W6 on bs2, gemma4nv-b2-t3): base2 on commit 1fd77e64b0 (base a9871012 + Triton small-M BF16 GEMM) with SGLANG_OPT_USE_TRITON_SMALL_M_BF16_GEMM=1, routing the decode-M o_proj and dense MLP BF16 linears off cuBLAS's SM80 WMMA fallback. Same definition as W6's bs2 ref.

base2.description: Pinned base2 (W5): base plus T-W32b's --mem-fraction-static 0.76, kept on bs3 (W32 x1.49, W8/W1 neutral, fidelity pass). The KV pools hold W32's 32 x 1152 tokens without retraction and leave room for the teacher-forced logprob peak.

base2-splits16.description: T2 stacked on base2 (W5, variant of the bs2 T2 trial): base2 plus Triton decode attention split-KV count 16 (tree default 8).

smallm-gemm-t3c.description: T3c (W7, gemma4nv-b2-t3c): smallm-gemm (base2 + T3, switch on) on commit 826d472504, whose allowlist adds qkv_proj (sliding and full), the 128-expert router (split-K 8) and the tied lm_head to the Triton small-M BF16 GEMM; see trials/T3c-smallm-qkv-router-lmhead.md.

smallm-gemm-t3b.description: T3b (W7, gemma4nv-b2-t3b): smallm-gemm (base2 + T3) on commit ed0aefcd40 with SGLANG_OPT_USE_TRITON_SMALL_M_FP8_WEIGHT_GEMM=1, which stores both o_proj shapes as FP8 E4M3 with per-output-channel scales (decode on the Triton small-M kernel, prefill on cuBLAS over the bf16 upcast); changes numerics and the loaded weights; see trials/T3b-fp8-weight-oproj.md.

base2-splits16-smallm.description: T3 stacked on base2-splits16 (W5, bs3): commit 1fd77e64b0 with SGLANG_OPT_USE_TRITON_SMALL_M_BF16_GEMM=1 on top of base2 plus split-KV 16.

base3.description: Pinned base3 (W5): base2 + split-KV 16 (T2S, kept on W1 TPOT -1.94%) + Triton small-M BF16 GEMM on commit 1fd77e64b0 (T3S, kept on W8 composite 1.0457), both on bs3.

base3-mtp5.description: T-SPEC1 (W8, gemma4nv-b2-tspec1): base3 plus MTP speculative decoding with google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-assistant (BF16, 4 layers, frozen target KV; NEXTN promotes to FROZEN_KV_MTP), 5 drafts per round, topk 1, on at every batch size. --max-running-requests 48, --speculative-draft-model-revision main and --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 32 restate what the speculative hook resolves anyway (48, main, and a finer decode-graph bs grid up to the same 32), so the gate's arg diff sees them declared; see trials/T-SPEC1-mtp5.md.

base3-mtp5-svk.description: T-SPEC2 (W8, gemma4nv-b2-tspec2): base3-mtp5 (T-SPEC1, MTP k=5) on commit c99575c4f52f with SGLANG_OPT_USE_TRITON_SPLITKV_VERIFY_CUDA=1, which runs Triton TARGET_VERIFY attention through the split-KV verify kernel (occupancy split count, sliding-window layers, tiled stage 2) instead of extend_attention_fwd's one program per (seq, head); see trials/T-SPEC2-splitkv-verify.md.

base3-mtp5-svk-m078.description: T-SPEC2b (W8, gemma4nv-b2-tspec2b): base3-mtp5-svk with --mem-fraction-static 0.78, the smallest probed fraction whose sliding KV pool (38.9k tokens) holds W32's 36.9k with the MTP drafter loaded; leaves 5.67 GB free after graph capture vs base3's 5.22 GB; see trials/T-SPEC2b-pool078.md.

base3-t3b.description: T3b stacked on base3 (W9, gemma4nv-b3-t3b, variant of gemma4nv-b2-t3b): base3 on commit 36aa977541 (base3's 1fd77e64b0 + cherry-picks 826d472504, bbbf5e4d46, ed0aefcd40; python/ tree identical to ed0aefcd40) with SGLANG_OPT_USE_TRITON_SMALL_M_FP8_WEIGHT_GEMM=1: both o_proj shapes stored as FP8 E4M3 with per-output-channel scales, decode on the Triton small-M kernel, prefill on cuBLAS over the bf16 upcast.

base4.description: Pinned base4 (W9): base3 + T3b's FP8 E4M3 weight-only o_proj (commit 36aa977541, SGLANG_OPT_USE_TRITON_SMALL_M_FP8_WEIGHT_GEMM=1), kept on bs3 (gemma4nv-b3-t3b: W8 composite 1.0142, W1 TPOT -4.03%, decode KL 0.025) and adopted on full GSM8K (delta -0.23 pt, paired 95% CI [-0.92, +0.47]) with tool-JSON 100 -> 100.

base4-glue1.description: T4 sub-step A (W9b, gemma4nv-b3-t4): base4 on commit 1d859709ef (36aa977541 + Gemma4 fused decode glue) with SGLANG_OPT_GEMMA4_FUSED_GLUE=1: q/k/v RMSNorm + RoPE + FP8 KV-cache store in one Triton kernel per layer (activations and KV bytes bit-identical to the unfused path).

base4-glue2.description: T4 (W9b, gemma4nv-b3-t4): base4 on commit 1d859709ef with SGLANG_OPT_GEMMA4_FUSED_GLUE=2: sub-step A plus the post-attention norm pair, the router / pre-FF-2 norm pair and the next layer's input norm in the dual-norm epilogue (270 of 392 glue launches per decode step removed; norm sums reordered).

base4-spec.description: T-SPEC3 (W10, gemma4nv-b2-tspec3, variant of gemma4nv-b2-tspec2b): base4 on commit c99575c4f52f (36aa977541's python tree + the split-KV verify switch; nothing else differs under python/) with T-SPEC2b's speculative stack: MTP assistant drafter k=5 (as base3-mtp5), SGLANG_OPT_USE_TRITON_SPLITKV_VERIFY_CUDA=1 and --mem-fraction-static 0.78; see trials/T-SPEC3-base4-spec.md.

base4-spec-fp8head.description: T-SPEC4 (W10, gemma4nv-b2-tspec4): base4-spec on commit 3d1732c505 (c99575c4f52f's tree + the FP8 MTP head; nothing else under python/ differs) with SGLANG_OPT_MTP_FP8_LM_HEAD=1: the MTP assistant's tied 262144 x 1024 head is stored as FP8 E4M3 with per-row scales and draft logits run on the Triton small-M FP8 kernel; the target and its verify are unchanged; see trials/T-SPEC4-mtp-fp8-head.md.

base4-spec-fp8head-qkvfp8.description: T-SPEC6b (W12, gemma4nv-b2-tspec6b): base4-spec-fp8head on commit c9b595d5a3 (3d1732c505's python tree + the FP8 weight-only allowlist extended to both qkv_proj shapes, max_m 256 with 32-row M blocks; nothing else under python/ differs). The inherited SGLANG_OPT_USE_TRITON_SMALL_M_FP8_WEIGHT_GEMM=1 now also stores qkv_proj as FP8 E4M3 per output channel; see trials/T-SPEC6b-fp8-qkv-verify.md.

base4-spec-fp8head-fp8lmhead.description: T-SPEC6c (W12, gemma4nv-b2-tspec6c): base4-spec-fp8head on commit dd5361a7bc (3d1732c505's python tree + an FP8 E4M3 per-row copy of the target's tied 262144 x 2816 head in gemma4_mm.py, used for logits batches of at most 48 rows; the per-tile max_m plumbing; T-SPEC6b's qkv entries removed, so o_proj routes as before) with SGLANG_OPT_GEMMA4_FP8_LM_HEAD=1; see trials/T-SPEC6c-fp8-target-lm-head.md.

base4-spec-fp8lmhead-k6.description: T-SPEC7 (W12, gemma4nv-b2-tspec7): base4-spec-fp8head-fp8lmhead with MTP draft depth k=6 (7 verify tokens) on commit 43039cd0f2 (dd5361a7bc + the FP8 target head's max_m 48 -> 64, so a B=8 verify of 56 rows stays on it; a no-op for k <= 5 at B <= 8); see trials/T-SPEC7-mtp-k6.md.

base4-spec-fp8lmhead-oprojtiers.description: T3d (W13, gemma4nv-b2-t3d): base4-spec-fp8head-fp8lmhead on commit 350d053100 (dd5361a7bc's python tree + M tiers for the FP8 weight-only o_proj: Triton with capped BLOCK_M up to M=8192 instead of the bf16 upcast + cuBLAS route above M=32); see trials/T3d-oproj-fp8-m-tiers.md.
